item.summary: test(ui): give the run-inspector bottom-bound assertion its real sub-pixel tolerance Broke the main gate on run 31865993941 (checks-ui-e2e 2/12): expected 609.81 <= 609.21. The preceding scroll poll tolerates a <=1px remainder because scrollHeight/clientHeight are integer-rounded, while measureWithinAncestor compares fractional getBoundingClientRect values, so the true bound is 2px, not 1.
